summary.text: Nico Rios is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 23 (Williston), serving since 2023. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Agriculture and Human Services.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Rios works as a casing hand.
In the interim he serves on the Human Services Committee and the Rural Health Transformation Committee.
